tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the app shell (`body`). Cool off-white; panels sit on it in `bg-elev`.

tokens.name: bg-elev
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: sidebar, topbar, panels, stat cards, default buttons, download options.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: table header row, rewrite cards, disabled track-option cards.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, session items, nav links, default and ghost buttons; disabled button fill.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `bg-elev` and `bg-sunken` (15.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, `.muted` copy, breadcrumbs, ghost buttons, nav links. 5.5:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: overline labels, table headers, session meta, breadcrumb separators. Only 3.1:1 on `bg` / 2.9:1 on `bg-sunken` — below 4.5:1 for its small sizes; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel/card outlines (1px). Decorative; not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Default button border and dropzone dashed edge. 1.5:1 on white — below 3:1 for a control border; kept exact.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary buttons, links, active nav/session, piano-roll notes, focus border on the dropzone. 5.3:1 on white; white text on it 5.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill and border. Literal in style.css (no variable); name added here.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: active nav link, active session, accent badge, drop icon, enriched download option. `accent` on it 4.75:1.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Soft 4px focus/drag halo around the dropzone (`box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px`).

tokens.name: mark-gradient-end
tokens.usage: End stop of the app mark's 140° gradient from `accent`. Literal in style.css; name added here. Use only on the mark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text: success flash, ok badge, harmonics articulation. 3.8:1 on `bg`, 3.6:1 on `ok-soft` — below 4.5:1; kept exact.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint behind `ok` text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and the mute articulation; Hydra setting note heading. 3.4:1 on `warn-soft` — below 4.5:1; kept exact.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint: warn badge, Hydra setting note background.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Error text: error flash, danger button label, preview errors. 4.8:1 on `err-soft`.

tokens.name: err-soft
tokens.usage: Error tint behind `err`; danger button hover.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral status text: default badge, count pill, `art-other` pill. 4.9:1 on `neutral-soft`.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral tint behind `neutral` text; chip background.

tokens.name: art-staccato
tokens.usage: Piano-roll note fill for staccato. Literal in style.css; name from its class.

tokens.name: art-tremolo
tokens.usage: Piano-roll note fill for tremolo picking. Literal; name from its class.

tokens.name: art-tapping
tokens.usage: Piano-roll note fill for tapping. Literal; name from its class.

tokens.name: art-harmonics
tokens.usage: Piano-roll note fill for harmonics. Literal; name from its class.

tokens.name: art-other
tokens.usage: Piano-roll note fill for any other articulation. Literal; name from its class.

tokens.name: mod-vibrato
tokens.usage: Vibrato modifier pill text, on `mod-vibrato-soft`. Literal; name from its class.

tokens.name: mod-vibrato-soft
tokens.usage: Vibrato modifier pill background.

tokens.name: mod-bend-slide
tokens.usage: Bend/slide modifier pill text, on `mod-bend-slide-soft`. Literal.

tokens.name: mod-bend-slide-soft
tokens.usage: Bend/slide modifier pill background.

tokens.name: mod-legato
tokens.usage: Legato modifier pill text, on `mod-legato-soft`. Literal.

tokens.name: mod-legato-soft
tokens.usage: Legato modifier pill background.

tokens.name: mod-pinch
tokens.usage: Pinch-harmonic modifier pill text, on `mod-pinch-soft`. Literal.

tokens.name: mod-pinch-soft
tokens.usage: Pinch-harmonic modifier pill background.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Big number in a stat card (`.value`); add tabular numerals.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: App name in the sidebar brand — always lowercase.

styles.name: stat-value-sm
styles.usage: Longer stat values in wide cards (`.small-value`).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base UI copy (`body`). Dense tool UI: 13px, not 16.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button labels (`.btn`), table cells and breadcrumbs share 12.5px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Session meta, brand subtitle, time labels, processing-report lines.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: stat-card label, table header (`.label`, `.tbl th`). uppercase, letter-spacing .06em.

styles.name: mono-chip
styles.usage: Chips of technical values: track tags, program/channel (`.chip`).

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Prompt editor textarea and file names (`.mono`, `code`).

styles.name: tab-print
styles.usage: PDF tab printouts rendered by tab_print.py (fpdf size 6 pt ≈ 8px). Not used in the web UI.

spacing.note: style.css defines no spacing variables; these are the literal steps it repeats.
